name: inwink
description_en:
inwink connects event management and ongoing B2B communities. Its current site organizes work before, during and after the event: registration, websites, exhibitor sales, onsite access, networking, content reuse and analysis. inwink Community extends member content and interaction between editions.

The published offers distinguish one event, one community and annual access to both. Annual capacity is based on identified contacts, while organizers and exhibitors are described differently. This profile synthesizes the French official pages into English and Chinese; that translation does not establish available software-interface languages.
description_zh:
inwink 连接活动管理与持续 B2B 社区。现行网站按会前、会中和会后组织报名、网站、展商销售、现场访问、交流、内容复用及分析，inwink Community 延伸两届活动之间的会员内容与互动。

公开方案区分单活动、单社区及两者的年度访问，年度容量按已识别联系人计算，组织者与展商另有定义。本文根据法语官网撰写英中档案，不因此确认软件界面语言。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect registrations, onsite engagement, content and continuing member interaction.
core_features.explanation_zh: 关联报名、现场互动、内容及持续会员互动。

core_features.explanation_en: A contact is identified by a unique email; annual offers include event/community modules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 联系人按唯一邮箱识别，年度方案包含活动/社区模块。

en: Carry a conference’s registration, attendance and replay content into a continuing B2B community.
zh: 把会议报名、出席和回放延伸到持续 B2B 社区。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose one-event/community or annual contact scope, budget onboarding and validate a contact through registration, attendance and CRM/export.
steps.zh: 选择单活动/社区或年度联系人范围，预算培训，再核对联系人贯穿报名、出席和 CRM/导出。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual unique-contact capacity or one-event/community offer, plus onboarding and optional packs/services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: EUR excluding tax: annual Standard €15,000/5,000 contacts, Premium €30,000/25,000, Enterprise €60,000/100,000. Starter Event €4,800/1,000 registrations; Starter Community from €5,900 via distributor. Mandatory onboarding excluded; optional services, contacts and webinar credits extra. No inwink ticket percentage does not remove processor fees.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 欧元未税：年度 Standard €15,000/5,000 联系人，Premium €30,000/25,000，Enterprise €60,000/100,000；Starter Event €4,800/1,000 报名，Starter Community 经分销商起 €5,900。必需培训不含，可选服务、联系人和直播额度另费。不收 inwink 票款抽成不免支付商费。

sources.title: inwink - Plateforme Événementielle et Communautaire
sources.research_notes_en: French-language official platform covers before/during/after events and year-round Community; direct reading not translated product UI assertion.

sources.title: Pricing inwink Event et inwink Community - inwink
sources.research_notes_en: EUR ex-VAT annual contact tiers and single event/community offers; unique email contact definition, mandatory extra onboarding, no automatic renewal and payment-provider separation.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Keep registration, attendance and community participation distinct
sections.title_zh: 区分报名、到场及社区参与
sections.en: An illustrative trade conference can collect registrations and exhibitor information, manage badges and meetings, then publish replays into the community. Each stage produces a different signal: registration is not attendance, and viewing a replay is not a qualified sales lead. Confirm the connector fields and consent before sending engagement to a CRM. AI recommendations and generated content require review; no workflow or AI output was tested here.
sections.zh: 例如行业会议可收集报名与展商资料、管理徽章和会面，再把回放发布到社区。各阶段信号不同，报名不是到场，观看回放也不是合格销售线索。发送互动数据到 CRM 前需确认字段和同意，AI 推荐及生成内容需复核。本文未测试真实流程或 AI 输出。

sections.title_en: Use unique-contact capacity rather than event count
sections.title_zh: 按独立联系人容量而非活动数比较
sections.en: Annual Standard lists €15,000 for 5,000 contacts, Premium €30,000 for 25,000 and Enterprise €60,000 for 100,000, with twelve-month commitment and prices excluding tax. Annual cards include unlimited events, communities, exhibitors and back-office users. A contact is a person identified by a unique email; exhibitors have a company-management back office and organizers have role-based accounts. Ask how duplicate emails, changed addresses and imported contacts affect the total.
sections.zh: 年度 Standard €15,000/5,000 联系人，Premium €30,000/25,000，Enterprise €60,000/100,000，承诺 12 个月、未税。年度卡片列不限活动、社区、展商和后台用户。联系人按唯一邮箱识别，展商有公司管理后台，组织者有角色账户。需确认重复邮箱、更换地址及导入如何影响总量。

sections.title_en: Add onboarding and services to the published amount
sections.title_zh: 在公开金额之外加上培训与服务
sections.en: Starter Event is €4,800 for one event with 1,000 registrations and 25,000 emails/month. Starter Community starts €5,900 via the named distributor. Mandatory onboarding for new clients is excluded from displayed prices; optional CSM/partner support, extra contacts and webinar credits can add cost. inwink says it takes no ticket percentage, but external payment processors remain separate. It also says contracts do not automatically renew; confirm your particular agreement.
sections.zh: Starter Event €4,800，单活动 1,000 报名、每月 25,000 邮件；Starter Community 由指定分销商提供，起 €5,900。新客户必需培训不在展示价内，可选 CSM/合作伙伴支持、额外联系人和直播额度另费。inwink 称不按票款抽成，但外部支付商另计；条款说明不自动续约，仍需核具体协议。

sections.title_en: Plan the people and data work around the platform
sections.title_zh: 安排平台之外的人员与数据工作
sections.en: The CSM provides advice rather than producing the customer’s content; certified partners can do setup, web, logistics or production. Hardware comes through partners. inwink merits investigation for recurring event/community programmes needing a common contact record. A minimal RSVP may not justify annual scope. No self-hosted package, source license, payment/refund, hardware, export or recovery was tested or established; vendor security and outcome claims were not independently audited.
sections.zh: CSM 提供建议，不负责制作客户内容，认证合作伙伴可做配置、网站、物流或制作，硬件也经合作伙伴提供。需要共同联系人记录的持续活动/社区可研究 inwink，简单 RSVP 未必适合年度范围。本次未测试或确认自托管、源码许可、付款/退款、硬件、导出及恢复，也未独立审计安全和效果。

research_gaps: No registration, contact deduplication, exhibitor portal, badge, CRM sync, Community, AI or export was tested.
Onboarding/service prices, contact counting edge cases, processor/hardware costs, contract data terms, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
